scripts.dev:full: pnpm db:migrate:local && pnpm build && wrangler dev .output/server/index.mjs --assets .output/public -c wrangler.dev.jsonc --port 3000
scripts.release:installer: pnpm build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.installer.jsonc --outdir .installer/bundle && node scripts/build-installer-release.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c wrangler.dev.jsonc

AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate a random 32+ character value. This signs login sessions.

APP_NAME.description: Name shown beside the Discoflare logo and in the page title.

APP_TITLE.description: Login headline. Use \n to split it across two lines.

APP_SUBTITLE.description: Supporting copy shown below the login headline.

AUTH_REGISTRATION_MODE.description: Initial signup policy: invite_only (default) or open. The owner can change it later.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional verified Cloudflare Email Service sender. An EMAIL send binding is also required.

EMAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Optional display name for verification emails.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional GitHub OAuth client ID. Deployment credentials override settings entered in Discoflare.

TWITTER_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 client ID for Sign in with X. Configure `/api/auth/callback/twitter` as the callback path.

TWITTER_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 client secret for Sign in with X.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Optional Cloudflare Turnstile site key for email signup.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional Cloudflare Turnstile secret key for email signup.

REALTIMEKIT_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional RealtimeKit account ID. Deployment credentials override settings entered in Discoflare.

REALTIMEKIT_API_KEY.description: Optional Cloudflare API token with Realtime permissions. Store this as a secret.

VAPID_SUBJECT.description: Web Push contact URI, normally mailto:admin@example.com.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Stable URL-safe P-256 public key generated by pnpm vapid:generate.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Stable URL-safe P-256 private key. Store this as a secret.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email for the first owner account.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Strong password for the first owner account (8+ characters).

ADMIN_NAME.description: Display name for the first owner account.

AGENT_MODEL.description: Default Workers AI model for workspace agents. The included default is @cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code.
